nodes.label: AbstractDynamicSoundInstance
nodes.rationale: Base class for complex, looping, and state-aware sound instances (Starting, Running, Ending).

nodes.label: DynamicSoundManager
nodes.rationale: Singleton manager for tracking and controlling dynamic sound instances on the client.

nodes.label: ExampleModDataGenerator
nodes.rationale: Entrypoint for Fabric Data Generation to programmatically create JSON assets.

nodes.label: UpgradingRecipe
nodes.rationale: Custom recipe implementation for an 'upgrader' workstation.

nodes.label: FabricModelProvider
nodes.rationale: Base class for generating block and item models via data generation.

nodes.label: ItemModelGenerators
nodes.rationale: Responsible for generating item models and client item JSONs.

nodes.label: BlockModelDefinitionGenerator
nodes.rationale: Contains blockstate variants, rotation, and options like UV lock.

nodes.label: CommandRegistrationCallback
nodes.rationale: Fabric API event for registering Brigadier commands.

nodes.label: CustomRenderPipeline
nodes.rationale: Demonstrates creating a custom rendering pipeline for waypoints visible through walls.

nodes.label: CustomSounds
nodes.rationale: Registry for custom SoundEvents.

nodes.label: FabricAdvancementProvider
nodes.rationale: Provider for generating advancements via data generation.

nodes.label: FabricBlockLootSubProvider
nodes.rationale: Provider for generating block loot tables.

nodes.label: FabricRecipeProvider
nodes.rationale: Provider for generating crafting, smelting, and other recipes.

nodes.label: FabricTagsProvider
nodes.rationale: Provider for generating tags for items, blocks, etc.

nodes.label: LootTableEvents
nodes.rationale: Fabric API events for modifying, replacing, or post-processing loot tables.

nodes.label: ModAttributes
nodes.rationale: Registry for custom entity attributes like AGGRO_RANGE.

nodes.label: SheepShearCallback
nodes.rationale: Custom event interface for shearing sheep, created using Fabric's EventFactory.

nodes.label: SimpleCriterionTrigger
nodes.rationale: Base class for custom advancement criteria triggers.

nodes.label: TaterBlock
nodes.rationale: Custom block that deals custom 'Tater' damage when stepped on.

nodes.label: TaterEffect
nodes.rationale: Custom MobEffect that gives experience points every tick.

nodes.label: TextureMapping
nodes.rationale: Provides identifiers that point to textures by associating a TextureSlot with an Identifier.

nodes.label: AI Software Engineer Role
nodes.rationale: Defines the expert AI persona and safety constraints for Minecraft mod development.

nodes.label: Safety Through Education
nodes.rationale: Design philosophy prioritizing scientific fidelity in hazardous systems to educate players.

nodes.label: AttachmentRegistry
nodes.rationale: API to attach arbitrary data to Entities, Block Entities, Levels, and Chunks.

nodes.label: FabricDynamicRegistryProvider
nodes.rationale: Provider for generating dynamic registry entries like enchantments or worldgen features.

nodes.label: Codec
nodes.rationale: System for serializing and deserializing Java objects, used extensively in dynamic registries and data attachments.

nodes.label: DynamicRegistries
nodes.rationale: Registries populated at runtime from JSON files in data packs, supporting server-only or synced data.

nodes.label: Class Tweakers
nodes.rationale: Transformation tools for access widening, interface injection, and enum extension in Vanilla classes.

nodes.label: Fabric Loader
nodes.rationale: Lightweight mod loader that executes code during initialization and transforms classes via Mixins.

nodes.label: Fabric Loom
nodes.rationale: Gradle plugin for Fabric mod development, handling obfuscation, remapping, and run configurations.

nodes.label: Mixin
nodes.rationale: System for transforming Java bytecode at runtime to modify game behavior.

nodes.label: MiniGolemEntity
nodes.rationale: Custom entity class extending PathfinderMob with attributes, goals, and synchronized data for a dancing animation.

nodes.label: MiniGolemEntityModel
nodes.rationale: Defines the 3D model parts and animations (walking, dancing) for the Mini Golem.

nodes.label: MiniGolemEntityRenderer
nodes.rationale: Handles the client-side rendering of the Mini Golem entity.

nodes.label: ModEntityTypes
nodes.rationale: Registry class for entity types and their attributes.

nodes.label: AcidFluid
nodes.rationale: Abstract class for a custom fluid that extends FlowingFluid and implements custom entity effects (hurt, weaken, blind).

nodes.label: ModBlocks
nodes.rationale: Registry class for block instances, including the LiquidBlock for the acid fluid.

nodes.label: ModFluids
nodes.rationale: Registry class for fluid instances (Source and Flowing).

nodes.label: HotTaterEntity
nodes.rationale: Custom projectile entity that sets blocks/entities on fire upon impact.

nodes.label: HotTaterItem
nodes.rationale: Item class that implements ProjectileItem to spawn HotTaterEntity.

nodes.label: ModItems
nodes.rationale: Registry class for item instances, including the BucketItem for the acid fluid.
